lines.text: Many learners say: I have twenty years.
Better: I am twenty years old.
For age, use am, not have.
Is! He is twenty years old.

data.why: For age, use am, not have.
data.memory: Age: I am, not I have.

native.tip: En anglais, on ne « a » pas un âge : on dit “I am twenty years old”.

en.tip: In English, you do not “have” an age: you say “I am twenty years old”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I have twenty years”? In English the right way is “I am twenty years old”. Listen to Ama and repeat with her! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
